outcome_definition: Outcome = percentage of SNPs in each of the four classes in a whole-genome variant set (I = C/T and G/A transitions, II = other transversions, III = G/C, IV = A/T). A population composition, not an HRM outcome; it bounds how often a class III/IV SNP - the hardest for HRM - appears.
